nom: Curology Gentle Face Wash for Sensitive Skin

avis.texte: I've been using Curology for a while now, and it's become a staple in my skincare routine. One of the standout features is how clean my face feels after each use. Unlike many other cleansers, it doesn't leave my skin feeling stripped of moisture, which is crucial for maintaining a healthy skin barrier. The cleanser has a modest lather – not too much, but just enough to feel effective. This balanced formulation is perfect for my sensitive skin, as it cleanses thoroughly without causing irritation or dryness. It is also a great size, which last me at least a month, even with consistent use (at least once a day, sometimes twice). The smell is very mild, I don’t believe they add any fragrance so I don’t really notice any smell at all. The texture is light. I don’t really notice any ‘foaming’ as this name implies, just a really light lather. I also don’t use any tools to wash my face, just my hands. You might get some foam if you use a sponge/brush/cloth. I also recommend pairing it with the moisturizer from the same brand (the gel one - I never used the cream one). Together, they create a skincare combo that I don't see myself changing anytime soon. If you have sensitive skin and are looking for a gentle yet effective cleanser, I highly recommend.

Curology Gentle Facial Cleanser has been a game changer for my sensitive skin. I have dealt with acne since I was 12 years old and I am now 48. This by far has been the best thing for my skin. No embarrassing harsh breakouts anymore! My complexion looks better and my T-zone on my face is clear. With Acne products, you basically have to do trial and error. What works for someone else may not work for you. This formula is gentle on the skin and you will start to see results within the 1st week of use. I finally found a product that truly works well with my skin. I am so Grateful. I highly recommend and I will continue to purchase.

Hope it is a good product as I was only able to use one time. The cap broke and fell part , as soon as i pumped it. I have never seen something so purely made for a cleanser. Seems others have said this as well. It is thick, and will not pour out of the bottle, will not move ! so i have no way of using it. I was thinking of ordering another, and hope I get a top that works, and save it for the bottle, but is just a waste of time, as I might get another poorly made useless top. So I will move on to something else, and i will not buy it from Amazon, as they must be aware of this problem.

I’ve been using this cleanser for a while now, and it has made a huge difference in my skin. My acne hasn’t cleared up 100%, but it’s definitely improved compared to where I started. I can really tell it’s working because if I get lazy and skip washing my face for a day or two, my breakouts start coming back almost immediately. The cleanser is gentle, doesn’t leave my face feeling tight or dry, and does a great job of cleaning my skin without irritation. Since my acne isn’t completely gone, I think I’m going to try Curology’s acne cleanser next to see if that gives me the extra boost I need. Also, do yourself a favor and get the matching moisturizer! It’s amazing. It keeps my skin hydrated without feeling greasy, and the cleanser and moisturizer work so well together. Overall, I’d definitely recommend this cleanser if you’re looking for something gentle that helps improve acne while keeping your skin healthy. I’ll continue using Curology because it’s been one of the best skincare brands I’ve tried.

I’ve been using Curology’s cleanser for about 7 years now and it’s the only one that doesn’t irritate my skin and keeps my skin clear and healthy. It doesn’t dry it out or leave it feeling oily. A go-to for me!
My daughter uses curology for moisturizer and a cleanser and it’s the only thing that keeps her skin from drying out too bad. Also helps keep her acne under control.

avis.titre: I wish it did just a little bit more -
avis.texte: I have really sensitive acne prone skin. Most of the gentle/simple cleaners on the market like Cetaphil and Cerave don't work for me at all. This one feels very comparable to texture and smell of those basic cleansers (fragrance free), however, it doesn't irritate my skin whatsoever. I use it as the second step in my double cleanser routine and it does the job without making my face feel like it's stripped of moisture. 4/5 starts because it's not a holy-grail type of product for me. I wish it cleared closed comedones, but it doesn't do that. It's a really simple-feeling cleaner. If you have normal, non-acne prone skin, you'll most likely love this no-fuss cleaner.

This is my go to favorite gentle cleanser. I love that it doesnt break my skin out. The texture feels velvety soft. Going on my second bottle.

This is a nice facial cleanser, it seems more gentle and moisturizing than most. The soap is a white creamy lotion like liquid. The pump works effectively and the top of the pump can be turned clockwise to lock or counterclockwise to unlock or open it so that it can be pumped. I did not realize at first was that there is a “C”-shaped ring of plastic under the top of the pump, which must be removed in order for the pump to be pressed down. I have attached a photo of that plastic ring when it is nearly fully removed so that you can see what I mean, so that you should have an easy time opening it. That ring is a little bit tricky to remove, basically it needs to be pushed across so that it opens wider, and you may need to just pull that ring open a bit as you try to slide it off. I don’t appreciate any particular scent to this soap. It is particularly smooth and soothing when applied, feeling more like you are applying a moisturizing lotion, but then it does wash effectively. I hope this information might be helpful for you. I like it.
Love this product and have been using it for years but this time it came fully broken with seal fully ripped off

This review is for Curology Gentle Cleanser, Lightly Foaming Gel Face Wash, Sensitive Skin Care, Fragrance Free, 5.07 fl oz. Nice gentle face wash. Easy to apply and wash off. I thought it would be more foaming and light (vs lightly foaming) but it was thicker than what I had expected. It’s nice though and feels rich and smooth. Even though it is supposed to be fragrance free, I thought it still had a light fragrance to it which I actually kind of like. I like the bottle and it looks nice. I like how the pump is protected by a removable clip to prevent accidental presses while in transit. Overall, a very nice lightly foaming gel face wash and works great on my partly oily skin. I’d give it a 4.8/5.0 - 01/02/2024.
